name: Corn Stover Collection
notes:
First added to GREET1_2014 values on Nov.14, 2014.

Updated cell IDs  in GREET1 2019 for a special item of N2O, which accounts the credit of N2O due to "N in N2O Avoided per Unit of Corn Stover Removed" calculated using the term defined in EtOH DU490. 

= -$C$60*E$94*$G$15)*44/28 = 7000 * 1.14 * 1.225%

N content in corn stover (g/dry ton) * Ratio of Harvested/Collected and Transported Biomass (dry ton/dry ton) * N2O Emissions: N in N2O as % of N in N fertilizer and biomass * 44/28
